sections.heading: Counting in Hungarian
paragraphs: Hungarian numbers from 0 to 10 are: nulla, egy, kettő, három, négy, öt, hat, hét, nyolc, kilenc, tíz.
Use these numbers when counting objects, prices, or quantities in everyday situations like shopping.
Questions like 'mennyi?' (how much?) and nouns like 'ár' (price) are useful when buying items.

sections.heading: Shopping & Quantities
paragraphs: When shopping, you can combine numbers with nouns to ask for quantities.
